_comment: Fabric Data Pipeline for the NovaCart medallion lab. Notebook steps refer to notebooks by name; setup/pipeline_tool.py swaps in their ids at deploy time. Every step: 2 retries, 60 s apart, 1 h timeout. Any failure skips the steps after it, so 'gold' ends Failed or Skipped and the on-failure path runs.

on_failure.fail_message: NovaCart pipeline failed; see the failed step in Monitor. An alert was recorded by notify_failure.
